pull_request.body:
Adds a patch to force the controller to be read as a guitar
Adds support for adjustable audio offset based on what I did for GH2GYM, but currently exposing the offset as the cvar "gh2_audiooffet"
Adds some missing function chunks
Names some functions
Fixes a couple function sizes to account for jump tables
Adds the out dir to gitignore
pull_request.title: guitar forcing, audio offset, functions
